title: wg: room-policy-04 §5 fixed_membership 'ordinary users' undefined
description: Suggestion. §5 says in a fixed_membership room 'ordinary users cannot leave or be removed' but never defines 'ordinary' (all participants? roles without remove capabilities? non-banned?), and it is unclear how this interacts with canRemoveSelf/canRemoveParticipant/canKick. mimid does not enforce it in v1 (decision mimid-1wgh.3.50). Fix: define it in terms of roles/capabilities.
notes:
Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): CONFIRMED minor: fixed_membership leave/remove not tied to capabilities. New issue.

Filed 2026-10-18: https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-room-policy/issues/37
